Shared values reused already-read G values; exact-string segmentation reused literal substrings, including serialized JSON, without paraphrasing. The mappings are recoverable from the fixed inputs, ordered file lists below, DFS order, and type-sensitive canonical JSON encoding with sorted keys and compact separators.

For manifest recovery, split original lines while retaining newline and delimiters at inline-backtick spans, Chinese full stop/semicolon, pipe, and Chinese parentheses. Retain surrounding whitespace and whether a span was backticked. Resolve exact known paths/full hashes/hash prefixes/byte strings against the table; decompose new code paths into directory/basename when applicable; assign remaining exact strings V numbers on first encounter. The ordered per-line map retains all repeated occurrences and original formatting. Segment first-origin line labels accompanied the actual reading.
